title: [WIP] Fix incorrect links in docs/components
body:
## Fix Incorrect Links in docs/components and Related Files

### Problem
The links in the documentation were using incorrect paths. The site uses `/docs` as the baseUrl (configured in `apps/site/lib/source.ts`), but the links throughout the documentation were missing the `/docs/` prefix.

### Changes Made
- [x] Analyze the issue and understand the URL structure
- [x] Fix all component category links in `docs/components/index.md`
- [x] Fix all individual component links in `docs/components/index.md`
- [x] Fix "Next Steps" and "Need Help?" section links in `docs/components/index.md`
- [x] Fix all component links in `docs/guide/interactive-demos.md`
- [x] Fix all plugin links in `docs/guide/interactive-demos.md`
- [x] Fix concept and reference links in `docs/guide/interactive-demos.md`
- [x] Fix links in `docs/guide/index.md`
- [x] Fix links in `docs/guide/studio.md`
- [x] Fix all plugin links in `docs/plugins/index.md`
- [x] Fix links in all plugin documentation files (plugin-editor.mdx, plugin-kanban.mdx, plugin-charts.mdx, plugin-markdown.mdx, plugin-object.mdx)
- [ ] Verify the changes by checking the generated documentation site
- [ ] Test that links work correctly
